services.desc: Here at Sharks, we believe every individual has the power to SHINE! Our mission is to create an inclusive, supportive and empowering environment for athletes with disabilities to thrive in the world of cheerleading. Our experienced coaches are dedicated to providing personalized training that emphasizes safety, fun, and skill development. They are trained to adapt techniques and routines to ensure every athlete can participate fully and confidently. We also have wonderful athlete volunteers to help support our program.
